technique_name: Compare and contrast the actions of a responsible citizen
description: A responsible citizen is someone who actively contributes to their society and lives in a way that respects the rights and freedoms of others. Responsible citizens not only obey laws, pay taxes, and fulfill other obligations, but they also perform civic duties such as voting in elections and volunteering. They strive to be open-minded and compassionate, and demonstrate respect for diversity in their communities. Additionally, they strive to be well-informed and take action to help make the world
